notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 - Fixed crashes happening after missions.
notes.notes:
Fixed the mission numbering and crashes that might happen after missions.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 - Pathfinding and mission fixes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.8 has bugfixes and a main menu, with some things meant to lead up to the addition of endless mode.

[list]
[*] A new save button at the management menu
[*] A new main menu
[*] Fixes to unit pathfinding preventing movement in some cases
[*] The flamethrower ammo cost is now cheaper
[*] the AN-47 ammo cost is now cheaper
[*] Fixes to a bug that resets mission progress if you play a previous mission
[*] Quit now returns to main menu
[/list]

Thank you for your support.
